verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robot simulator: its documented surfaces (gz-sim server and GUI, gz-transport messaging, plugins, and the ros_gz bridge) all operate on simulated worlds. Commanding a real robot end-to-end with scoped credentials belongs to a hardware or fleet-control platform, not a simulator, so this axis is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows Gazebo shipping real-robot control or credential-scoped API access that would make the axis apply.
